BC_description: 'async.memoize' no longer caches error results. Previously, if the callback passed to 'async.memoize' produced an error (i.e., called back with a non-null 'err'), the error result was cached, and subsequent calls with the same arguments would receive the cached error. As of this change, error results are not cached—each call that results in an error will execute the underlying function again. This affects all uses of 'async.memoize' with asynchronous functions where errors may occur.
